subjects.displayTitle: Breakdown and renewal: learning to give life
subjects.introduction: Every human act leaves something behind it: cohesion or estrangement, learning or ignorance, a harvest or a wasteland. ‘Abdu’l-Bahá sets the choice starkly. While others sharpen swords, lift an olive branch; while nations think hate, think love with all your powers. Bahá’u’lláh adds that fairness is the very measure of being human, and that oppression and its agents will pass while justice endures. The breakdown is real: wars that breed lasting hatreds, armaments that drain nations, a heedlessness that sleeps through its own warnings. The seed that rots in the ground is the figure to hold onto, since its dissolution is what yields the harvest, and the flood that wrecks a town may be the prelude to rebuilding. The Qur’an’s image of foam that passes while what benefits people remains, and Paul’s counsel to overcome evil with good, sharpen the question of how to serve renewal without growing numb to present suffering. From here the path leads into material and spiritual civilization, into present and future calamities, and into the long argument between war and peace.
subjects.arc: Open with giving life and the conditions of cohesion; confront injustice, prejudice and the costs of war; examine material and spiritual civilization; read historical trials, opposition and reversal in their source settings; return through discernment and steadfastness to constructive service.

order.why: Contrasts love’s power of integration with hatred’s destructive effects.
Open with giving life, offering flowers and building humanity.
Ask how unity and enmity differ in what they produce.
Ground the inquiry in the cohesion of living forms.
shortened: When thou dost consider all phenomena, thou wilt see that every created thing hath come into being through the mingling of many elements, and once this collectivity of elements is dissolved, and this harmony of components is dissevered, the life form is wiped out.

order.why: Consider the seed whose dissolution yields a harvest.
shortened: When you scatter a seed in the earth, that seed decomposes and becomes annihilated beneath the soil, yet that very annihilation is the cause of its permanence, that dispersion leads to gathering, and that dissolution results in the formation of great abundant harvests.

order.why: Make wisdom and utterance the explicit means of advancing the Cause.
shortened: In all Tablets it has been revealed that the victory of God's Cause today has been and will be through wisdom and utterance, not through conflict and contention.

order.why: Answer the reported prevalence of hate with the full power of love.
Pray for the transformation of the wolves themselves.
Read fairness as a measure of humanity.
Confront the direct prohibition of tyranny.
Look for the enduring influence of work that comforts humanity.
shortened: The end is loss upon loss, except for souls who lay the foundation of eternal glory and the basis of comfort for the world of creation, and adorn the world with the light of the gift of the All-Merciful. Even the whispers of such souls remain forever permanent and endless.

order.why: Distinguish passing oppression from enduring justice.
shortened: Soon shall oppression and its perpetrator pass away, while justice and its manifestations shall endure, by the decree of the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Read the passing foam beside what remains useful to people.
shortened: Soon shall the carpet of acceptance be rolled up and the couch of indolence spread out. The floods shall leave naught but traces, and the pampered ones shall fall from palaces to graves. The throes of death shall seize them and intense regrets shall overtake them, when there shall be no escape, and no sound nor trace of them shall be heard. As for the foam, it passeth away as scum upon the surface, while that which is useful to mankind remaineth in the earth.

order.why: Follow the reported exposition of the Quranic water and foam imagery.
Distinguish material victory from a victory that gives life.
shortened: Victory is of two kinds: material and spiritual. Material victory is not so important but spiritual victory is conducive to the life of the world of humanity.

order.why: Test professed truth through deeds.
shortened: Strive that by your deeds you may bear witness to the truth of these words of God, and beware lest, by "turning back," He may "change you for another people," who "shall not be your like," and who shall take from you the Kingdom of God.

order.why: Hear the reported warning to apply the remedy and consider the needy world.
Confront a society in which ruthlessness commands respect.
shortened: The darkness of enmity has encompassed the world and the swords of cruelty and oppression are in the hands of the misguided. There is hardly a fair-minded soul to be found anywhere nor any who does not oppress others in some form. Only those who are most greedy and most ruthless, most bloody and most brutal seem to command respect.

order.why: Read the reported discarding of loving counsel through self and passion.
shortened: They have cast those precious jewels into the furnace of self and passion. They have set aside those loving counsels and admonitions, and have arisen in such oppression and aggression as hath never been witnessed in the world.

order.why: Trace disorder to intentions, self-worship and ambitions.
Picture mutual destruction beside the canopy of peace.
Keep the cost in human blood before the reader.
Question violence justified in the name of protection.
Read the reported betrayal of justice in mutual slaughter.
Hear the reported horror at the killing of brothers.
Keep the reported reversal from shepherds to wolves.
Ask why repeated destruction has not brought awakening.
Attend to mothers, children and ruined communities in the Balkans.
Trace the spread of war through misunderstanding.
shortened: All the peoples of the world are opposed to each other and day by day their misunderstanding increases. This is why the fire of war has reached to the heavens.

order.why: Recognize strife across religious, political and economic life.
Read the warning about racial hatred in America with its call for healing.
shortened: The world of America should be grateful for this matter, for this enmity and hatred that exists between these two races, black and white, is very dangerous and without doubt will eventually end in bloodshed - unless the power of the Word of God and the breaths of the Holy Spirit and the teachings of Baha'u'llah spread and bring healing between these two groups, uprooting the foundation of hatred and animosity and laying the basis of love and the path of unity.

order.why: Retain the supplied warning about agitation between races in its historical setting.
shortened: These enemies are agitating both sides, that is, they are stirring up the white race against the colored race and the colored race against the white race. But of this the Americans are submerged in the sea of ignorance. They will regret it. But of what use will their regret be after the destruction of America?

order.why: Consider the supplied account of war’s wider disruption of life.
Examine the reported moral as well as financial costs of armaments.
Read the reported invisible war of continuing expenditure.
Keep the historical account of war, disease and agitation attributed to its source.
shortened: It is medically proven that from the abundance of dead bodies and fiery explosions the air changes, and from the change in air numerous diseases result and spread to other regions. Certainly millions of souls killed on the battlefield must change the air, and from the change in air diseases arise. Similarly, from psychological disturbances severe agitation results in humans, and certainly from severe agitation various diseases are born.

order.why: Distinguish the supplied reasoning about armaments from a claim to prophecy.
Read the supplied appeal to prevent an explosion of accumulated dangers.
Keep the reported postwar hatreds and social divisions within their historical context.
Consider the supplied criticism of religion enlisted for war.
shortened: It is now demonstrated that all their existent powers have contributed something toward the realization of this world war, even their so-called Christian religion has been made a pliable instrument for the promotion of war purposes.

order.why: Test peace conferences against the wine-seller analogy.
Read the criticism of a distracted League assembly.
Recognize the reported economic pressures alongside military power.
shortened: Today the Armies of Europe, well-drilled, well-provisioned, phalanx-like are like unto the waves of the ocean attacking Asia. Asia in her present state cannot stand before these irresistible, victory-inspired armies. There is not only the army of war; there are other more influential, economic armies that are surrounding the Eastern countries. There is an army of commerce, an army of industry, an army of agriculture, an army of science and arts. All these well-disciplined hosts, supplied with the latest modern methods and instruments are bent upon great conquests in their respective fields.

order.why: Retain the historical description of East-West struggle.
Keep the supplied statement about social and intellectual disintegration.
Ask what happens when industrial ability multiplies instruments of destruction.
Read the reported limits of material civilization alone.
Distinguish competition in aggression from competition in virtues.
Consider material civilization infused with spiritual qualities.
Retain the supplied body and mirror images applied to Europe.
Read the supplied images of beauty without fruit or fragrance.
Consider the supplied fish image of a limited field of awareness.
Read the reported release from captivity to nature.
Keep the reported effects of spiritual civilization in human lives.
Read the supplied account of the Manifestations as educators of human qualities.
Connect religious light with justice and public security.
Consider the elixir image of transforming diverse elements.
shortened: The dross of nations has seized them; the greatest elixir is required. O Wise One! Has the crown of victory such power as to transform diverse elements in a single thing and bring them to the station of pure gold?

order.why: Keep the particular appeal for a remedy to turmoil in Fars.
Read the teachings through peace, fellowship and security.
shortened: The teachings of Baha'u'llah are, in this day, the very spirit of life; they are the cause of peace and security, the source of fellowship and love, the means of the unity of the human world.

order.why: Consider the proposed remedy for the social fevers of hatred.
shortened: Note thou: could these fevers in the world of the mind, these fires of war and hate, of resentment and malice among the nations, this aggression of peoples against peoples, which have destroyed the tranquillity of the whole world ever be made to abate, except through the living waters of the teachings of God? No, never!

order.why: Read the appeal for a power sufficient to meet turmoil.
Keep the stated need for power beyond nature to overcome strife.
Examine spiritual brotherhood as a means of removing war’s causes.
shortened: The spiritual brotherhood which is enkindled and established through the breaths of the Holy Spirit unites nations and removes the cause of warfare and strife. It transforms mankind into one great family and establishes the foundations of the oneness of humanity.

order.why: Consider the claim that spiritual light can transform a long winter.
Read the role of education alongside the condition of receptivity.
shortened: It is certain that spirituality will defeat materialism, that the heavenly will subdue the human, and that through divine education the masses of mankind generally will take great steps forward in all degrees of life---except for those who are blind and deaf and mute and dead. How can such as they understand the light? Though the sun's rays illumine every darkest corner of the globe, still the blind can have no share in the glory, and though the rain of heavenly mercy come down in torrents over all the earth, no shrub or flower will bloom from a barren land.

order.why: Hear the reported connection of knowledge, service and unity.
shortened: "The Light of Knowledge hath appeared, before which the darkness of every superstitious fancy will be annihilated.  The Hosts of the Supreme Concourse are descending to assist all those who rise up to serve their Lord, to subdue and gain the victory over the city of the hearts; to proclaim the Glad-Tidings of the Coming of GOD and to united the souls of His creatures."

order.why: Picture prejudices melting into a common garden.
Read the reported call to abandon imitations and prejudice.
shortened: Awake, O people of the world, awake! Give heed, O peoples and nations, give heed! Destroy the mot of conflict and strife; abandon imitations and prejudices which lead to cruelty, so that you may acknowledge the Truth and the light of the oneness of humanity may shine brilliant and manifest as the sun; the standard of universal peace be hoisted; perfect love and harmony may reign among the races, religions and nations; and the world of man may find peace and acquire a divine image and likeness.

order.why: Join freedom from imitation to truthful service.
Locate constructive service to Iran in moral and ethical effort.
Imagine the education of souls as a country’s illumination.
shortened: Now the Lord has cast a glance of favor, and the witness of heavenly bounty has appeared in the land of Iran. The Sun of Truth has risen and cast its rays of grace upon that country, and heavenly teachings have spread and a divine faith has come forth. The hope is that the rays of this sun will make the land of Iran like the celestial realm - that is, souls will be educated who, like bright stars, will shine in the heights of that country.

order.why: Keep the reported gradual implementation of needed laws.
Retain the reported relation between strikes and common laws.
shortened: A.B.---- Now everywhere there are strikes. It is very strange- It is necessary that all the nations and peoples should make laws and regulations. At the end all the nations will be united so that no one can break those laws and regulations.

order.why: Look within self-interest as a source of estrangement.
shortened: Today the nations of the world are self-engaged, occupied with mortal and transitory accomplishments, consumed by the fires of passion and self. Self is dominant; enmity and animosity prevail. Nations and peoples are thinking only of their worldly interests and outcomes. The clash of war and din of strife are heard among them. But the friends of the Blessed Perfection have no thoughts save the thoughts of heaven and the love of God.

order.why: Read heedless action and disregard for consequences beneath continuing waves of disorder.
Hear the warning about sleep, desire and ensuing calamity.
shortened: Despite this, people are still caught in the sleep of negligence, clinging to the metaphorical and shunning reality. People are still so immersed in carnal desires that even the trumpet of Israfil would not awaken them. Surely this heedlessness, ingratitude for divine bounties, and lack of awareness will lead to regret, hardship, war and strife, and bring about loss and calamity.

order.why: Keep the parallel warning about ingratitude and unawareness.
shortened: Despite this, people are still captive in the sleep of heedlessness, clinging to the metaphorical and averse to reality, and still so immersed in carnal desires that even the trumpet of Israfil would not awaken them. Surely this heedlessness, ingratitude for blessings, and lack of awakening will cause grief and hardship, war and strife, and bring about loss and calamity.

order.why: Distinguish ignorance, pride and desire within the image of darkness.
shortened: The regions of the world, cities and villages in the East and West are encompassed by the darkness of ignorance and rebellion - the darkness of unknowing, the darkness of pride, the darkness of self and desire have combined. These triple darknesses, layer upon layer, have formed, leaving souls bewildered, wandering, and drowning in the sea of heedlessness and forgetfulness.

order.why: Ask why people remain unaware of the causes of upheaval.
shortened: O Mihdi! The world is in upheaval while the people remain heedless. The dust of the deeds and words of the veiled ones hath obscured the luminous morn. Today every firm and mighty foundation is shaken, and every steadfast and upright foot hath faltered, save those whom thy Lord hath willed. The world's convulsions increase daily, yet its people perceive not the cause and reason, and remain veiled from what is with God by what is with themselves.

order.why: Confront unrecognized bondage to suppositions.
shortened: The fire of suppositions and idle fancies has encompassed the world, and supreme abasement has seized the people, yet none are aware of it.

order.why: Read the puzzle of lethargy amid abundant opportunity.
shortened: Despite the fact that the outpouring of grace encompasses all, and the bounty of the Most Glorious Kingdom surrounds both the great and the lowly, and the melody of the Supreme Concourse reaches the ears of both young and old, still there is coldness and lifelessness and lethargy that has encompassed those who are frozen.

order.why: Keep the tension between worldwide light and inward imaginings.
shortened: O servant of the Ancient Beauty!
The lights of the Greatest Name have encompassed the horizons of all nations, yet the heedless remain submerged in the depths of vain imaginings.

order.why: Consider the inability of a stirring melody alone to awaken hearers.
Retain the particular criticism of heedlessness in Iran.
shortened: The East and West have been stirred into motion by the breezes from the rose garden of mysteries, yet the Iranians are still captive in the sleep of heedlessness.

order.why: Read revealed mysteries beside continuing veils.
shortened: The lights have shone forth and the mysteries have appeared and the verses have been sent down, yet the people remain in evident veils. The hidden treasure hath been revealed and the concealed secret hath appeared, yet most of the people are among the heedless ones.

order.why: Hold the few who see beside confidence that darkness will pass.
shortened: Despite this, the veil has so obscured vision that among the people of the world only a few are enlightened while all the rest remain captive to the darkness of the furnace. However, the rays of the Sun of Truth have become so brilliant that this darkness cannot endure.

order.why: Consider deeds of passion as clouds obstructing light.
Read the projection of one’s own motives upon the divine.
shortened: However, those souls who are deprived of sincerity and purity have imagined the True One to be like themselves, and therefore strive and struggle to extinguish the divine light.

order.why: Examine inherited conjectures as part of awakening.
shortened: In these days, in one of the Tablets this blessed word hath dawned from the horizon of the Supreme Pen: Until thou becomest aware of the falsehood of the past, thou shalt not bear witness to the truth of this wondrous Day. The heedless people must be awakened that they may recognize the daysprings of conjecture and fancy of the past and future, and may hold fast to the straight path and the firm and mighty cord.

order.why: Read the supplied thief and householder analogy of different desires for light.
Consider contamination and withering as consequences of unwise seeking.
Keep the reported appeal for mastery of oneself amid moral disorder.
shortened: Just at this time a mad wave of evil habits, immoral acts, shameless customs and most lewd representations is sweeping over some parts of the world, it seems that the very gates of hell are flung wide and the ghastly fiends of unbridled desires, dissolution, sensualism, unchastity and debauchery are set loose, desecrating the sanctity of the homes and polluting the clear stream of morality. Now the friends of God must do their utmost to purify the world from the stains of these licentious habits. They must master their innate God-given forces and strike at the very root of these evil deeds and social scourge.

order.why: Pray for protection from greed, treachery and falsehood.
Hear the two contrary calls raised together.
Keep the supplied parallel statement of those calls.
shortened: Two calls are raised in the contingent world: one the call of the All-Merciful, the other the call of Satan.

order.why: Return to the distinction between the calls from different directions.
Read the moral qualities behind the opposing light and darkness images.
shortened: The forces of good and evil have raised aloft their banners in the world of humanity and, in the arena of tests and trials, are locked in battle. The light of good shineth forth from the countenances of the friends of God, even as the darkness of evil hath become manifested in the gloomy faces of the haughty and the proud. The faces of the former are the dawning place of the light of guidance, whereas the latter are the depths of utter darkness; the one is manifest light, the other is enmity, malice and spite. The former is the temple of the spirit, the latter the body of death itself. How great is the difference, how clear and evident is the distinction.

order.why: Keep the supplied classification of spiritual and material orientations attributed.
shortened: First of all we have to establish the fact that all human beings fall into only two categories: into spiritually oriented beings centred on God, and into materially-minded ungodly beings far removed and estranged from God, depending on the degree of their centrifugal development.

order.why: Read the supplied test of union and discord by their fruits.
shortened: In the world everything which promotes union, harmony, and love is from God, for union is life, but everything which causes discord is from Satan and is death and annihilation.

order.why: Retain the supplied account of destructive differences.
shortened: Such differences as between the wolf and the sheep, for instance, between light and darkness, water and fire, are the cause of enmity. Water extinguishes fire in the same way that religious differences cause annihilation.

order.why: Keep the reported contrast between revelation and suggestion.
Guard the heart while keeping its gaze upon truth.
Read the supplied shooting-star image in relation to understanding and love.
shortened: O people! Stand firm in the Cause of God and in the praise of His Self, and when ye behold Satan seeking to ascend unto the heaven of understanding that he may discover what is in your hearts of the love of the All-Merciful, drive him away with the shooting stars.

order.why: Hear the Fire Tablet’s plea against pervasive whisperings.
shortened: The whisperings of Satan have been breathed to every creature: Where is the meteor of Thy fire, O Light of the worlds?

order.why: Keep the warning concerning an influence that leads astray.
shortened: The idolaters rush headlong toward the Evil One. Say: He dwelleth in the lowest depths of the fire. We have shown them who led them astray from the straight path that they might recognize him and seek for themselves a way of escape unto God.

order.why: Read the contrast between turning and heedlessness.
shortened: They who have turned unto the Countenance are the people of Baha in the Crimson Book, and they who remained heedless are among the people of the fire.

order.why: Retain the joy and fire imagery of belief and wavering.
Consider the opposed settings of the different birds.
shortened: O thou who art intoxicated with the wine of the love of God! Indeed, the wings of the peacock spread out in the midmost heart of paradise and the crow croaked in the ruinous waste. The Dove sang in the thickly planted grove of faithfulness and the owl screeched in the ominous land.

order.why: Keep Covenant imagery within its contrast of steadfastness and dismay.
Examine revelation described as revealing discord and distinct character.
shortened: No sooner had that Revelation been unveiled to men's eyes than the signs of universal discord appeared among the peoples of the world, and commotion seized the dwellers of earth and heaven, and the foundations of all things were shaken. The forces of dissension were released, the meaning of the Word was unfolded, and every several atom in all created things acquired its own distinct and separate character.

order.why: Consider new life as a force moving hearts and consciences.
Read the world as a fresh creation through revelation.
Let the concise declaration of change frame the following images.
Read the earthquake as the movement attributed to revelation.
Keep the earth’s shaking and raised cry together.
shortened: The earth hath been shaken in these days and the cry hath been raised between earth and heaven. Thus hath the matter been decreed from the presence of the Lord of the Throne above and of the earth below.

order.why: Receive the concise description of peoples in agitation.
shortened: Earthquakes have appeared and the tribes have lamented, and the people are in manifest agitation.

order.why: Picture foundations trembling.
shortened: The pillars of the earth are quaking and the foundations of humanity are trembling.

order.why: Read the supplied account of cracks in seemingly secure realms.
Consider an unexpected change from misleader to guide.
shortened: Say to 'Ali, upon him be My glory: "The Truth hath secretly assisted the one who was occupied with abasement. The world hath changed, the mountain moveth, the sun speaketh, the vibration of the manifestation hath set Mount Sinai in motion. Glory be to God! It is as though the Resurrection is at hand and the Hour hath appeared. The one who led astray hath become a guide."

order.why: Receive the language of resurrection in its stated moment.
Hold the Tablet of the Test’s grace and reversal together.
Place the summons to service within a world-shaking Cause.
Keep the veiled relation of events to divine will.
shortened: Were We to lift the veil, thou wouldst witness the people circling round the will of thy Lord, Who ruleth over all that are in the heavens and on earth.

order.why: Read the discernment of providence amid mischief and darkness.
shortened: Darkness hath fallen upon every land, and the forces of mischief have encompassed all the nations. Through them, however, I perceive the splendors of Thy wisdom, and discern the brightness of the light of Thy providence.

order.why: Retain the supplied contemplative statement and blessing upon sincerity.
shortened: Although in one sense this servant observes that just as it is, is beloved, as was said before: "Nothing in creation is more perfect than what is."

Blessed are the sincere ones. Today is the day of the sincere ones. Today is the day of those drawn nigh. They drink from the cups of recognition despite the people of creation, and they partake of the Kawthar of life, hidden from those who have denied the All-Merciful.

order.why: Keep the reported reversal of high and low stations attributed.
shortened: He replied: "This refers to the great disturbance which is to occur in that day -- the latter day. That those souls who occupy the highest stations shall be reverted to the lowest and the souls who occupy the lowest degrees shall be promoted to the highest.

order.why: Include the reported separation of family members.
shortened: The power of the Word of God has rent asunder the veils - how it has united us, given complete connection to hearts, made East and West one, brought the distant near, and made the stranger intimate! Yet from another perspective it has separated brother from brother and father from son.

order.why: Read the supplied explanation of collection and separation within families.
Keep the supplied account of physical and spiritual destruction through changed teachings.
shortened: The abomination of desolation is the one who appears and tries to destroy the Truth and who makes some changes in the teachings of GOD. He will destroy the foundation of the teachings of GOD from among the people.
His intention is destruction, and it is divided into two parts, one physical and the other spiritual.

order.why: Read the reported connection of broken promises and physical consequences.
shortened: Whenever a promise is broken, it causes a commotion. For instance, suppose two nations have a disagreement has a physical effect. It causes war, and thousands of men are cut in pieces. So, when man breaks his promise to God, in other words when he "violates the Covenant," the effect is physical, and calamities appear.

order.why: Retain the source fragment identifying internal, external and communal troubles.
shortened: On one side the attacks of the enemies from within, on another side the onslaught of the adversaries from without, still on another side the disunity among the friends.

order.why: Consider the vulnerability of apparently secure dwellings.
shortened: Consider how the diverse tribes, the many nations of the world and all our human kindred are like ants who make their nests under the layers of the earth where they store up their food. But when the sudden rains begin, when floods start to flow, then every little nest and all these homes are washed away and utterly destroyed.

order.why: Remember the passing of edifices, glory and dominion.
Read the end of tyranny through the example of earlier powers.
Keep temporal glory beside the mirage and summer cloud.
Retain the forceful imagery of overturned factions and revealed proofs.
shortened: The standards of divine unity shall be raised high, and the banners of the signs of your Glorious Lord shall wave upon the lofty edifice. The foundation of doubts shall be shaken, the veil of darkness shall be rent asunder, the dawn of clear proofs shall break forth, and the Kingdom of earth and heaven shall be illumined with the lights of His signs. You shall see the banners of the various factions brought low and their standards reversed, faces effaced and transformed, eyes vacant and sunken, hearts trembling and failing, houses empty and desolate, bodies weak and decaying, and souls plunging into the abyss.

order.why: Keep the supplied report of hostile ascendancy in its setting.
Pray from within the experience of being surrounded.
Read the particular warning about Iran and increasing discord.
Keep the account of reversals in Europe within its own setting.
shortened: Consider the upheavals in European lands ahead - all became hopeless, then new souls benefited. Those helpless ones suffered crises, then strangers came and seized the ball from the field.

order.why: Retain the reported expectation of a European conflagration.
shortened: The social unrest in all countries, the growing religious scepticism prophesied as antecedent to the millennium, will set aflame the whole of Europe, as is prophesied in the 1st of Daniel and in the Book of John.

order.why: Read the supplied historical interpretation of Malachi as an attributed account.
shortened: In Malachi Chapter 4, verse1: Since creation the world has been controlled by wicked people who have oppressed the good people. They have tortured the messengers of God but in this time, thorough the powers of Europe and America, justice has prevailed, oppression has been suppressed. The world has been put in a better condition and thus the wicked will be burned and have no power nor influence.

order.why: Keep the supplied interpretation of resurrection and war in its reported setting.
shortened: Those who are endued with spiritual insight see in th[is] small chapter a small portrayal of the present upheaval in all parts of the world for it demonstrates the depth of wisdom and divine perception of the founder of Islam. Many Koranic commentators have written pages after page[s] on the interpretation of this chapter referring their exegesis to the day of resurrection. We are now in the Cycle of resurrection and one of its manifold phases is the Universal War.

order.why: Retain the supplied prediction concerning governments without converting it into an editorial assertion.
Read the reported pillars as an image of a previous order’s remnants.
Keep the supplied prediction for a particular plain and its future inhabitants.
shortened: Now the flood of destruction hath reached its crest. From now on there will be a period of construction. This plain will be built and will become inhabited by a happy people. It will not take a long time this prediction will become fulfilled!

order.why: Read the supplied statement connecting current turmoil to recorded revelation.
shortened: The world is in turmoil and whatsoever hath been recorded and set down by the Pen of Revelation in the Sacred Tablets is now manifest and evident.

order.why: Consider unintended outcomes in both peace and calamity.
shortened: Sometimes a stupendous, unforeseen calamity results from the means intended for peace and quiet; and sometimes calamity leads to tranquility and rest, confusion precedes composure, and a destruction results in rebuilding.

order.why: Read the reported flood interpretation with attention to present suffering and hoped-for rebuilding.
shortened: Now the wisdom of this American disaster is not known to the many people of this generation, because they are too much absorbed in the immediate sufferings and hardships that it has brought in its train. When the flood is subsided and the people shake off the temporary gloom, they will then realize that after this destruction there is construction; after this suffering there will be blessing. After this death there will be life. After this darkness there will be light. After this loss there will be profit. After this devastation there will be upbuilding. After this havoc there will be prosperity. After this failure there will be success and after this war of elements there will be glorious peace and greater civilization.

order.why: Keep the reported storm and spring analogy.
Read the supplied birth metaphor and the difficulty of interpreting events nearby.
Retain the supplied interpretation of upheavals through a divine plan.
Consider the supplied image of a world growing new tissues.
Keep the supplied dramatic image within its interpretive setting.
Read the supplied hope that calamity may awaken attention.
Consider the stated purpose of awakening from self and desire.
Keep growing disorder beside the need for awakening.
shortened: Day by day chaos and disorder in the world are increasing. Finally it will reach such a degree that human nature cannot bear it. At that time awakening will occur and souls will become aware that religion is an impregnable fortress and faith is a manifest light and divine laws, counsels and teachings are the quickener of the earth.

order.why: Turn the experience of factional suffering toward making amends.
shortened: Now that the calamity of following the fatwas of thoughtless clerics has become apparent, and the result of party divisions has become evident, if they now awaken and undertake to make amends for what was lost, they will no longer count the friends of God as strangers, and will not consider souls following their own desires as well-wishers and kind ones, will not count wolves as shepherds, and will engage in love and unity, uproot the foundation of division, and make the counsels and advice found in the sacred tablets their course of action, once again times will become sweet as sugar.

order.why: Read the prospect of further hardship before order.
Acknowledge recurring waves as a feature of the work.
shortened: Although you are right - these events do disturb minds - yet this ship is always in the mighty ocean with continuous and successive waves, sometimes intense and sometimes mild. But calm and tranquility are impossible and unattainable. Rather, these are necessary aspects of the work and nothing new.

order.why: Hold the passing of bitter times beside the sea’s eventual calm.
Keep patience through the stated duration of disorder.
shortened: For a time it shall continue thus, even as the duration thereof hath been revealed and recorded in the Book of God. But be not thou sorrowful, for the effulgences of the Sun of Truth shall assuredly absorb the superfluous moistures of nature and shall gather together the scattered letters.

order.why: Read awakened conscience alongside trembling foundations.
Receive the reported hope for increased peacemaking after war.
Keep the reported growth of peace-loving people.
shortened: However, afterwards, the number of peace-loving people will grow considerably, and the commotions, uproars and the mighty tumult will precipitate [universal] peace.

order.why: Retain the supplied expectation that disgust with war may turn people toward peace.
Hear postwar hope with the source’s marked omission.
Notice that the clouds have only partly dissipated.
shortened: Praise to be God, the gloomy clouds of war have been partly dissipated from the horizon of the world. The hope is entertained that gradually they will utterly vanish and rest and comfort will be established.

order.why: Keep the reported longing for a speedy end to brutality.
Read the reported hope for rest beyond great-power competition.
Retain the supplied account of communal peace amid conflict.
shortened: The whole world has fallen upon each other. There is killing and plunder, there is beating, there is destruction. We, praise be to God, are in perfect love and peace, apart from all these conflicts and struggles.

order.why: Read the claim of preservation amid a universal tempest.
shortened: This universal tempest was so terrifying, frightening and dreadful that reason could not conceive that this oppressed community would remain protected and preserved in all lands. This is naught but through the extraordinary conquering power of the Desired One - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones' footsteps.

order.why: Connect preservation with the community’s peaceful purposes.
shortened: In any case, all the governments and peoples of the world have fallen into grievous torment from the fire of this universal war. The foundation of humanity was shaken and the human world fell into a great crisis. All peoples became the target of the arrows of calamities. Yet through the infinite favors of the Blessed Beauty, this oppressed party remained protected and preserved in all regions, and this is due to the blessedness of the divine teachings, for all nations and governments are certain that the Party of God has no purpose or intention except peace, reconciliation, the unity of the human world, and fellowship and kindness.

order.why: Keep the contrast between wider decline and the community’s ascent.
shortened: Observe that although this terrible war has uprooted the foundation of all peoples and all nations have fallen into great turmoil and compared to before have become disordered, have declined and reached a state of fall and descent - except these supplicating, imploring souls who are in the shadow of the favor of the Blessed Beauty and are day by day ascending and progressing while all others are falling and declining.

order.why: Retain the stated experience of safety through war.
shortened: Praise be to God that in these years of upheaval you have been protected in divine safekeeping, while most people are in the utmost turmoil and distress and all regions of the world have been consumed and inflamed in the fire of bloodshed. Yet the friends of God, through the blessedness of the divine teachings, have passed through the days of war in Asia, America and Africa in perfect peace and security, protected from all calamities and full of joy and delight.

order.why: Notice love and steadfastness growing during upheaval.
Examine persecution’s unintended effect on public inquiry.
shortened: Now since the doctors of Persia have no administrative capacity, they thought that violence and interference would cause extinction and silence and lead to suppression and oblivion; whereas interference in matters of conscience causes stability and firmness and attracts the attention of men's sight and souls; which fact has received experimental proof many times and often. So this punishment caused notoriety, and most men fell to making inquiry.

order.why: Trace awareness spreading through attempts to suppress it.
shortened: Indeed, the attacks and the obstructiveness of the ignorant but cause the Word of God to be exalted, and spread His signs and tokens far and wide. Were it not for this opposition by the disdainful, this obduracy of the slanderers, this shouting from the pulpits, this crying and wailing of great and small alike, these accusations of unbelief levelled by the ignorant, this uproar from the foolish -- how could news of the advent of the Primal Point and the bright dawning of the Day-Star of Baha ever have reached to east and west?

order.why: Consider the wisdom claimed in opposition increasing fame.
shortened: If their instigation and corruption did not exist, the fame of God's Cause would not be raised. In this there is wisdom for those who have insight.

order.why: Keep reassurance amid sedition beside confidence in the Word.
shortened: Say: Be not grieved by the fire of sedition and corruption that has been kindled through the hardness of men's hearts. I swear by the light of God's countenance, shining and manifest from the Most Exalted Horizon, these matters have been and are the cause of the exaltation of the Word of God.

order.why: Allow the enduring memory of wrongs to remain visible.
Read the response to persecution in Yazd.
Keep the reported account of opposition intensifying influence.
shortened: You observed what severe trials and tribulations befell this Cause in Iran. The Iranians thought this Cause had human foundations and that through government and people's opposition, its mention would be erased and forgotten from the pages of hearts. They did not understand that opposition, tribulation, killing of souls and great martyrdom would increase the influence of God's Cause and exalt the Word of God. Therefore the more they tried to extinguish this divine lamp, the brighter it became.

order.why: Consider the reported effect of polemical publications.
Read the supplied fire image of opposition increasing ardor.
shortened: Thus, even after the opposition and objection of kings and others, in every age the fire of the divine Tree hath enkindled the hearts of the servants, such that now in most lands the standards of His Cause are raised up. The murky waters of the objections of heedless souls cannot extinguish this fire; rather they cause it to blaze more fiercely.

order.why: Confront the scale of resistance described in the source.
shortened: Observe how different nations of the world are openly and evidently in constant war with the Blessed Cause, sparing no means to extinguish the kindled fire of God.

order.why: Read the reported defense of religious monopoly without proofs.
Keep the bats’ lament over a lost market as polemical imagery.
shortened: O thou who speaketh the praise of God!
When the Morn of Eternity illumined the horizon of the world, the bats were scattered, crying "Woe unto us! No scope or field remains for us, our shop and market are ruined!"

order.why: Hear the attempt to interrupt life-giving breezes.
shortened: O companions of `Abdu'l-Baha! The people of malice have stretched forth the hand of aggression, perpetrated injustices and acts of cruelty, and raised a clamor and cry that they might interrupt the life-giving breezes blowing from the paradise of Abha and conceal the lights shining from the Daystar of Truth.

order.why: Retain the reported uprooting of planted trees.
shortened: Wherever We go, We kindle a light. Our enemies, the violators of the Covenant, however, exert to extinguish that light. Wherever We plant a tree, our rebellious acquaintances try to uproot it.

order.why: Read events as exposing the difference between sedition and peace.
Consider the need for a new foundation amid incompatible factions.
Hold personal reassurance beside objections, fear, pride and wealth.
shortened: Say: Beware, O people of Baha, lest the strong ones of the earth rob you of your strength, or they who rule the world fill you with fear. Put your trust in God, and commit your affairs to His keeping. He, verily, will, through the power of truth, render you victorious, and He, verily, is powerful to do what He willeth, and in His grasp are the reins of omnipotent might.

How strange, how utterly strange, that most of the servants are seen to be deprived. Some are held back by the intoxication of pride, others by the intoxication of wealth, some by the conditions of self and desire, and yet others by the doubts and intimations of the divines, together with the turning away, objections and denial of the people of the earth.

order.why: Receive consolation when offered revelation is refused.
shortened: Grieve not if none be found to accept the crimson wine proffered by Thy snow-white hand and to seize it in the name of Thy Lord, the Most Exalted, the Most High -- He Who hath appeared again in His name, the Most Glorious.  Leave this people unto themselves, and repair unto the Tabernacle of majesty and glory, wherein Thou shalt encounter a people whose faces shine as brightly as the sun in its noontide splendour, and who praise and extol their Lord in this Name that hath arisen, in the plenitude of might and power, to assume the throne of independent sovereignty.

order.why: Keep the call not to be saddened by oppression.
shortened: O people of God! Let not the oppression of the oppressors sadden you. The Cause of God hath encompassed the world. Soon shall the standard of divine sanctification be raised through you and in your name throughout the world.

order.why: Read the sharp battle imagery of error and guidance.
Locate the spiritual battle’s objects in ignorance and misguidance.
Read lifelong service and knowledge as the preferred struggle.
Keep the supplied rhetoric of fighting tied to peace and brotherhood.
Receive the heavenly armies image in its devotional setting.
shortened: O promulgator of the Covenant! The hosts of the Abha Kingdom and the legions of the Most Exalted Realm are successively rushing down from the heavenly realm. The ranks and multitudes of the peoples of the nether world are consecutively routed, condemned and broken. Armies like waves are continuous and tumultuous forces are successive. With this overwhelming might and resplendent majesty and conquering strength and perfect power, assuredly soon "necks shall be humbled and voices hushed."

order.why: Keep the assurance of unseen assistance to the steadfast.
shortened: O friends steadfast in the Covenant and Testament! A hundred glad tidings that the hosts of the Abha Kingdom and the unseen legions have been dispatched by the Beauty of Baha to the East and West, and they have broken and continue to break the ranks throughout all regions.

order.why: Read the Kingdom’s armies as the source’s spiritual imagery.
shortened: The Kingdom hath advanced with its hosts, retinue, armies and banners, and cast its waves upon the desert of the contingent world. It hath pitched its tents in the valley of existence with its forces and legions, and soon shall its spiritual armies seize the pillars of the world.

order.why: Retain the concise description of routed armies.
shortened: The battle lines of nations are being successively broken, and thousands of armies of peoples are repeatedly being routed moment by moment.

order.why: Let the prayer for light’s victory join this sequence.
shortened: Therefore, O Lord of Hosts, confirm us so that the army of light may achieve victory and the forces of darkness may be defeated.

order.why: Compare the lasting influence of Prophets with armed opposition.
Keep the paired historical figures within that comparison.
shortened: In all the worlds, who is the victor? Yazid or the noble 'Ali, the Jews or the promised Christ, the powerful Herod or John the chaste, the prophet Noah or the foolish people, the illustrious Abraham or the despised Nimrod, and so forth.

order.why: Read the reported contrast between Napoleon’s force and Christ’s love.
shortened: Napoleon established his kingdom through the power of oppression while Christ established His through the power of the love of God. A hundred thousand Napoleons may be effaced but the Kingdom of Christ will remain forever.

order.why: Keep the reported crown of thorns beside spiritual victory.
shortened: Our own 'war' is good because it conquers all. When a crown of thorns was placed on the head of Christ, He saw with His own eyes the crowns of kings under His feet. Now, when I look, I see all the powers and nations defeated, scattered and lost in the wilderness while the Cause of God is victorious over all and subdues all.

order.why: Consider invisible power as inspiration for service.
Read the reported energy impelling service to fellow human beings.
shortened: Although invisible, yet it works its way through the hearts of the people, impelling them to rise and serve their fellowmen. It is the most irresistible, irrepressible energy in the world of creation. In a twinkling of an eye it removes the most insurmountable barriers and defeats the most determined army of opposition.

order.why: Retain the reported revolution in hearts and experience of assistance.
shortened: Observe how the power of the Cause of God has created a tumult in the hearts and what a revolution it has produced. See how the aid and assistance of the Abha Beauty have reached us constantly and invariably the lights of victory have shone from the supreme horizon.

order.why: Read victory through the conquering of hearts.
shortened: The confirmations of the Ancient Beauty are in every moment the intimate companion, and the victory of the Greatest Name in every breath conquers the hearts of the people of the world.

order.why: Keep the supplied account of bringing the Bab’s remains and building the Shrine.
Read the creatures opposing celestial powers as figurative polemic.
shortened: What ignorance is this, that a handful of dust should seek to eclipse the stars of heaven, that a few bats should pursue the concealment of the rays of the sun, that contemptible sparrows should seek the abasement of the soaring vulture of the ethereal realm, that lowly worms should seek to prevent the sweet fragrance of Paradise, that abject kites should desire the defeat of the glorious eagle, and that a weak gnat should covet the throne of Solomon, the king of existence.

order.why: Hear the insistence that attempted extinction cannot defeat divine light.
shortened: They desire to extinguish God's light with their mouths, but God refuses except to perfect His light, though the unbelievers detest it.

order.why: Consider clouds scattered by an effulgence.
shortened: The ignorant people and the indolent masses imagined that the accumulated clouds and piled-up mists would darken the Sun at the zenith of bounties and conceal it in the west of decline. But with one burning effulgence from the Dawning-Place of the unseen Kingdom, He so dissolved and scattered those dense clouds that minds were amazed.

order.why: Compare obstructing a spring with obstructing a sea.
shortened: The darkness of negligence shall not darken the light of truth, especially after it has set Africa and America ablaze. It may be possible and easy to block a spring, but what can be done about the sea? Cutting off the water of a stream is feasible, but how can one obstruct a mighty flood?

order.why: Keep the advancing ocean and rays that cannot be stopped.
shortened: O you who are stirred by the breezes of grace! In this Most Great Resurrection, when the services to the Ancient Beauty have set the heart of the world in motion, a group of the frozen and dead have imagined they can prevent the Most Great Sea from its advancing waves, or deprive the Most Glorious Orb of its dawn-time rays, or deny the horizons of nations from the continuous outpourings of this daybreak. Vain indeed are their deeds.

order.why: Read the supplied image of waves overcoming artificial barriers.
shortened: How thoughtless are those people whose aim is to [down] this Great Ocean. They construct around it with their puny efforts dams and fortifications, ramparts and embankments but the perennial waves of the Great Ocean beat against them and slowly, slowly, surely, unmistakably wash them all away into its own body, absorb them and leave behind not a single trace.

order.why: Retain the supplied sea metaphor and its exclusionary image.
Hear the reported hope for clouds of difference to disappear.
Receive reassurance amid dispersed affairs.
Read the prospect of light without malice’s veil.
shortened: Although the dust of malice hath prevented the light from shining forth, yet the time shall come when it will appear without any veil and illumine the whole world.

order.why: Keep the supplied hope for hidden stations to become manifest.
Consider clouds passing while the sun continues shining.
Read the rekindling of love after tribulation.
Receive the promise of spiritual radiance across the regions.
Read the Word as champion overcoming ignorance.
shortened: O Rustam! The people of tyranny desired to overthrow the divine ordinance. The divine champion, the Word of God, entered the arena, routed the army of ignorance, and with the rays of the Sun of Truth scattered the hosts of darkness. This radiant effulgence shone forth like the dawn, and the celestial Sun cast its rays. Day by day this light grows brighter and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

order.why: Keep the supplied vision of peace beyond the terror of war.
Confront the enduring reality of oppression and ignorance.
Ask what can dispel darkness and separation.
shortened: For this pitch darkness a dispeller is needed, and for these devastating trials a remover is required. For darkness there can be no dispeller save light, and for the sorrowful darkness of night there can be no remover save the luminous lamp.
Thus did the Lord kindle the lamp of guidance, and the heat of its blazing fire consumed the veil of separation from sincere seekers.

order.why: Question the assumption that estrangement is an inevitable human condition.
shortened: At a time when humanity was surrounded by the darkness of estrangement and alienation, when dissension, hatred, enmity and ignorance stalked the world, when negligence, selfishness and the rapacity of wild beasts had become common among men, when the horizon of the world had become so dim that everyone had forgotten about the existence of light and thought darkness an essential condition of humanity, something from which it was absolutely impossible to be free, suddenly the light of truth did shine, the horizon of the world was illumined and its rays were spread in the east and the west.

order.why: Read the two candles addressed in the breaking dawn.
shortened: O ye two candles of the love of God! The world of existence was darkness, and the contingent world was in blindness and gloom. Darkness was piled upon darkness, and error upon error. Light was wholly absent, and bewilderment and confusion were present. Then did the resplendent dawn break, and the brilliant Sun rent asunder the veil. The light of truth shone forth, and the glad tidings of union arrived.

order.why: Follow the dawn’s displacement of shadows.
Receive the illumination of souls and horizons.
shortened: O thou who art stirred by the breaths of God!
When the light of His Essence shone forth from the lamp of oneness, both the horizons and the souls were illumined, and the darksome dust became the dawning-place of the signs of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Read the shining beams from divine unity.
shortened: The shining beams of light emanating from the Sun of Truth have illumined the horizons of the world of creation and the rays issuing forth from the Kingdom of divine unity have lit up the realm of being.

order.why: Keep the Ancient Morn illuminating East and West.
Consider the claim that reality will overcome dogma.
shortened: This is the century in which the Divine Spirit pervades all things. This is the Age of Reality. The Sun of Reality will shine with such intensity as to entirely dispel the darkness of dogmas.

order.why: Retain the reported spring of toleration after fanaticism.
Hear the reported hope of unity after suppression.
shortened: The darkness of suppression will disappear and the Light of Unity will shine.

order.why: Read the reported dawn within hearts.
shortened: The darkness of this gloomy night shall pass away. Again the Sun of Reality will dawn from the horizon of the hearts.

order.why: Consider concealment followed by manifestation.
shortened: That darkness was transformed into light and that concealment led to manifestation. The lights of truth illumined the horizons and the fragrances from the garden of the All-Merciful perfumed all creation.

order.why: Receive the promise of night becoming day.
Keep first twilight distinct from fuller illumination.
shortened: Now this infinite divine bounty is like the morning twilight appearing from the Dawning-Place, and soon the Sun of Reality will shed such radiance that the world will become illumined and East and West will become brilliant and radiant.

order.why: Imagine creation becoming radiant.
Read the passing clouds and the hope of a garden.
shortened: Soon these dark clouds will disperse and this dust will settle and the true dawn will shine forth and the real sun will spread its rays. The world will become the gardens of the All-Merciful and the earth will become the Most Glorious Paradise.

order.why: Receive the image of the earth’s transformation.
shortened: Thus will the dark world become luminous, the satanic field transformed into the courts of the Merciful, the mound of earth become the mound of Heaven and the terrestrial globe the Eternal Rose-garden.

order.why: Let cruelty’s furnace become faithfulness’s garden.
Read the spiritual spring through human trees and new fruits.
shortened: The Sun of the divine world hath dawned from the horizon of the temperate, spring equinox, resurrecting into new life the countries of the orient and the occident. The mountain and prairie of the Ideal world are adorned with green and verdant vegetation. The trees of the temples of humanity are clothed with the garments of New Bestowals and be gemmed with New blossoms and fruits. A most tremendous stir or motion is witnessed in the world of creation. All the phenomena are in the process of reformation and regeneration and all the creatures are chanting the verses of oneness with their tongues of consciousness and reality.

order.why: Keep the well-rooted tree’s continuing fruitfulness.
shortened: Rather, this heavenly tree becomes more firmly rooted day by day, puts forth branches, displays blossoms, and yields goodly fruits. It is like the good tree mentioned in the verse: "A goodly word is as a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches reach to heaven, giving its fruit at all times."

order.why: Ask what endures in the lamp of love and the tree of the Kingdom.
Retain the particular hope for Turkistan and Transoxiana.
shortened: Now that the Sun of Reality has risen and the lights of the Most Great Luminary have shone upon Turkistan, the breeze of favor is wafting and the divine fragrances are perfuming the nostrils. Turkistan must become a rose garden and Transoxiana must receive its portion and share from the Most Great Sea.

order.why: Read Iran’s new dawn as renewing remembrance of earlier monarchs.
Keep illumination of East and West connected with revived hearts.
Retain the particular expectation concerning the West’s role.
Read the hope addressed to Germany.
shortened: My hope is that the region of Germany may become, through the effulgent rays of the Sun of Reality, a supreme paradise and a divine realm.

order.why: Keep the hope for Paris within its stated setting.
shortened: Even in the center of materialism, that is, Paris, the divine teachings have been established, and it is hoped that the spirit of holiness will overthrow the foundation of every devil, the lights of truth will shine forth, and the darkness will be dispelled.

order.why: Receive the reported emergence of a universal consciousness.
shortened: The thoughts of human brotherhood are permeating all regions. New ideals are stirring the depths of hearts and a new spirit of universal consciousness is being profoundly felt by all men.

order.why: Read the supplied confidence in changed hearts.
Consider the diffusion of teachings as a remedy for violence.
Keep the supplied appeal to moral education amid political division.
shortened: You must think now of spiritual affairs. Try to enlighten the morals and try to spread the teachings of Baha'u'llah, so that this fire of dissension which is burning in the world may be extinguished. It is impossible for the different nations and parties which exist now - such as socialists, Bolshevists, the extremists or radicals, strikers and those who wish for absolute authority, to leave these dissensions and be united - save through Baha'u'llah's teachings.

order.why: Read the supplied search for a lasting remedy.
shortened: Spiritual Light is the only thing that will banish the present gross darkness and our duty is to find the centre of that Light. All other remedies are palliative and not permanent.

order.why: Hear the supplied musical contrast between destruction and reconciliation.
shortened: Today from all the countries of the world discordant and harsh voices are being raised which have a jarring and disagreeable effect upon the hearts. Above and beyond this dissonant babel, the harmonious melody of the Kingdom of Abha is poured forth by the Bird of Paradise to calm the contentious spirits and soothe the wrangling hearts. How sad it is that one is forced to listen to the strain of the martial music sung by the soldiers as they march, column after column disappearing forever in the darkness of the night of destruction! Will they not lend their ears to the celestial concert played by the Angels of Peace?

order.why: Keep the supplied encouragement to persevere in love and peace.
shortened: Those who serve the Cause of Love are confirmed. Let nothing discourage you. Cry out the word Peace. Push ahead. Seest thou not the light?"

order.why: Read the supplied appeal for mutual affection amid turbulent conditions.
shortened: But the donkeys kick, the dogs bark, the wolves tear other animals to pieces and the beasts of prey play havoc in the animal Kingdom. We must not be like the latter but exercise towards each other perfect love and amity ...
The earth has periodic waves like unto the waves of the Sea. The rising of one earth-wave covers under it all these wars, revolutions, contentions and strives.

order.why: Consider the reported warning against ceasing to grow.
Keep the supplied account of growth through working for others.
shortened: There is no such thing as self-development. Growth only comes by working for others.

order.why: Imagine teaching as building bridges over threatening currents.
Remember actual construction undertaken amid turmoil.
Read the anticipated influence of the House of Worship.
Hear voices raised for peace amid the sound of cannons.
Cultivate composure and service amid other people’s tumult.
shortened: I hope that through the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom in these times when all parties are in tumult and upheaval, the friends of God may arise in perfect calm and composure and attraction to the divine fragrances and enkindlement with the fire of the love of God, and may become so radiant as to illumine both East and West.

order.why: Make the lamp’s brightness a present responsibility.
shortened: But now is a time when the lamps must be full-flamed and kindled and brilliant so they may resist and dispel the accumulated darkness.

order.why: Read the explicit dependence of illumination upon effort and conduct.
Keep steadfastness amid competing calls.
shortened: Convey greetings to all the friends from the True One and say: What is beloved today is steadfastness, for the call of the All-Merciful is raised and likewise the cry of Satan.

order.why: Receive the image of drinking steadfastness.
shortened: Today the Call of God is raised high, and likewise the cawing of Satan. Strive ye that ye may drink from the Kawthar of steadfastness.

order.why: Read firmness as protection against misleading influences.
shortened: That which is of paramount importance today is steadfastness in the Cause of God, inasmuch as the satans of the earth have been and are engaged in misleading and seducing the people.

order.why: Retain the supplied promise of a new order with its recorded reference.
Read the supplied two-edged force as an account of concurrent processes.
Keep the supplied interpretation of institutions and historical powers.
Consider the supplied pattern of opposition and renewed momentum.
Retain the supplied historical account and its opening omission.
Read the supplied lamp-and-oil image of trials.
Keep future hope beside the acknowledged limits of present understanding.
shortened: Who knows but that out of the turmoil which agitates the face of present-day society there may not emerge, sooner than we expect, the World-Order of Baha'u'llah, the bare outline of which is being but faintly discerned among the world-wide communities that bear His name?

Surely, we stand too near the colossal edifice His hand has reared to be able, at the present stage of the evolution of His Revelation, to claim to be able even to conceive the full measure of its promised glory.

order.why: Read the supplied tide image as encouragement to work toward renewal.
shortened: This is the ebb of the tide. The Baha'is know that the tide will turn and come in, after mankind has suffered, with mighty waves of faith and devotion. The people will enter the Cause of God in troops, and the whole condition will change. The Baha'is see this new condition which will take place, as one on the mountain-top sees the first glimpse of the dawn, before others are aware of it; and it is toward that that the Baha'is must work.

order.why: Retain the supplied call to prepare through sustained teaching.
shortened: The Faith advances, not at a uniform rate of growth, but in vast surges, precipitated by the alternation of crisis and victory.
This is the time for which we must now prepare ourselves; this is the hour whose coming it is our task to hasten.

order.why: Receive the supplied seed and future harvest as encouragement.
Close with the supplied invitation to keep larger possibilities in view.

questions: What do the opening passages suggest about recognizing the difference between actions that give life and actions that deepen division?
How do the images of seeds, storms, light, and enduring benefit help you think about change, and where might those images leave further questions?
What relationships do these readings establish among material progress, spiritual education, justice, and peace?
How can we read accounts of persecution, war, and future renewal with both hope and sustained attention to the people who suffer?
How do the Quranic image of passing foam and Paul’s counsel about responding to evil illuminate the compilation’s practical demands?
What might constructive service, discernment, and steadfastness look like amid present uncertainty, and which connected subject could deepen your investigation?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 13:17 · Foam and enduring benefit
references.note: The verse compares truth and falsehood through flowing water and smelted metal: foam passes away while what benefits people remains. Read the parallel translations and compare this image with its use in the compilation. What might usefulness to humanity reveal that immediate prominence does not?

references.label: 2 · Romans 12:17–21 · Overcoming evil through good
references.note: Paul urges peaceful conduct as far as possible, rejects personal vengeance, and calls for feeding and giving drink to an enemy. Read this counsel beside the compilation’s flowers, olive branch, wisdom, and utterance. Consider what it asks of a person who seeks change while facing hostility.

subjects.displayTitle: Recognizing a divine Educator: evidence and transformation
subjects.introduction: How does anyone recognise a divine Educator when He appears, and by what right do we accept one Messenger while refusing the next? Bahá’u’lláh answers that the first testimony is the Manifestation Himself, as the sun needs no proof beyond its own light, and after Him the verses He reveals and the lives He transforms: a nation of slaves raised to civilisation under Moses, a crucified Christ who subdued the world with no weapon but meekness. Jesus told His hearers to know a tree by its fruits [1], and the Qur’án challenged every human being to produce the like of a single verse [2]; the Báb insists that whoever lives by such a standard must apply it to a new claim as honestly as to the one already believed. The inquiry soon leads further, into the absence of schooling behind an ocean of revealed words, into miracles and how they ought to be understood, and into the nature of the Word of God itself, which goes on quickening hearts long after the generation that first heard it.
subjects.arc: Begin with fair inquiry and the fruits of education; examine the limits of spectacular signs; consider the Person and revealed Word; test consistency across successive revelations; read historical and scriptural arguments; return to learning, discussion and conduct.

order.why: Ask what an educator cultivates in lives.
shortened: The proof of the validity of a Manifestation of God is the penetration and potency of His Word, the cultivation of heavenly attributes in the hearts and lives of His followers and the bestowal of divine education upon the world of humanity. This is absolute proof. The world is a school in which there must be Teachers of the Word of God. The evidence of the ability of these Teachers is efficient education of the graduating classes.

order.why: Open with the limitations of ways of knowing.
shortened: Proofs are of four kinds: first, through sense perception; second, through the reasoning faculty; third, from traditional or scriptural authority; fourth, through the medium of inspiration.

Consequently, it has become evident that the four criteria or standards of judgment by which the human mind reaches its conclusions are faulty and inaccurate. All of them are liable to mistake and error in conclusions. But a statement presented to the mind accompanied by proofs which the senses can perceive to be correct, which the faculty of reason can accept, which is in accord with traditional authority and sanctioned by the promptings of the heart, can be adjudged and relied upon as perfectly correct, for it has been proved and tested by all the standards of judgment and found to be complete.

order.why: Require clear support for a claim.
Condense the educational criterion.
Exclude coercion as a measure of truth.
Distinguish religion from its misuse.
Compare personal assertions with supported explanations.
Look for the lives a teacher educates.
Consider the ability to unite hearts.
shortened: The greatest sign that a man is a Prophet is his ability to unite hearts - for no one can do this except he be on the part of God.

order.why: Explore arguments beyond shared scripture.
shortened: One sanctified Soul revives the world of humanity, transforms the face of the globe, develops the minds, quickens the souls, inaugurates a new life, establishes new foundations, orders the world, gathers the nations and religions under the shadow of one banner, delivers man from the realm of baseness and deficiency, and exhorts and encourages him to develop his innate and acquired perfections. Certainly nothing short of a divine power could accomplish this feat!

order.why: Connect reported development and knowledge.
shortened: The Power of the Manifestations of God is beyond question inasmuch as human development invariably follows their Teachings. This development is unmistakably toward a higher existence. Every Manifestation teaches the Existence of God. As their Power is evident their Knowledge must likewise be true.

order.why: Examine the reported breadth of teachings.
Keep the moral philosophy claim attributed.
Distinguish universal proof from individual whims.
Reject personal enrichment as a test.
shortened: You have made the acquisition of wealth your criterion for the truth of God's Cause.

For you sought help and intercession from the pure Imams (peace be upon them) and did not achieve your goal, therefore this cannot be the measure of the truth of God's Cause. If this were the criterion and it were fulfilled, no denier would remain in the world - East and West would all believe in a single day.

order.why: Compare competing miracle claims.
shortened: And now, concerning the proofs sought by the uninformed masses: these consist of miracles and marvels. To state the matter briefly, there are many accounts of such marvellous feats associated with Baha'u'llah that are current amongst the people and could fill numerous volumes, were one to compile them. But since these do not constitute a conclusive proof for the contending denier, we will not relate miracles associated with Baha'u'llah. For the contenders may also relate such accounts from the idols of their fancy and base them on their own books and chronicles. We therefore present rational proofs, so that there shall remain no room for denial for any soul.

order.why: Distinguish hearsay from evidence available to others.
shortened: If there were fairness, in this Most Great Manifestation the very appearance itself in all its aspects is miraculous. Even outsiders testify to manifest miracles outwardly. The people of Iraq in Baghdad were astonished. But we do not proclaim such matters since they are based on hearsay and do not constitute proof for others. However, all fair-minded ones testify that Baha'u'llah demonstrated miracles in all aspects, conditions and effects.

order.why: Read the reported priority of the message.
Consider evidence available to later centuries.
Look beyond the changing rod.
Read the Book of the Tigris on verses.
shortened: However, concerning that which hath been sent down from the heaven of bounty and the clouds of mercy in the Bayan, no universal proof or conclusive evidence hath been ordained save the revelation of verses. This hath ever been and shall ever remain God's proof unto the peoples of the earth.

order.why: Separate the Bab’s claim from ascetic feats.
shortened: Verily spiritual exercises and eating little are no proof in My case, for I neither tire Myself nor reduce My food due to My physical weakness. Rather, the proof is that I have no proof.

As for supernatural occurrences, I possess nothing for Myself, and there is no greater sign for Me than My words, for the light of the Eternal Morn hath shone upon Mine outward being like unto Mine inner mysteries.

order.why: Read spontaneous utterance as the stated proof.
Remember the limits of perception.
Connect sunlight with healing and development.
shortened: The greatest proof of a Manifestation is the Manifestation Himself. We do not have to prove the existence of the sun. The sun is independent of proof. He who has sight can see the sun and prove it for himself. It is not necessary to seek for other proof.

Another great proof of a Manifestation is His power to develop souls. Miracles are but secondary proofs. Our first and important duty is to ascertain if the real Physician has come to heal the Spiritual sickness of the world, to learn if the Commander of the hosts of righteousness has appeared, to prove the appearance of a true Manifestation of God.

order.why: Consider Christ’s transformation through meekness.
shortened: Consider how Christ, alone and single-handed, with no helper or protector, with no legions or armies, and with the utmost meekness, raised aloft the banner of God before all the peoples of the world; how He withstood them; and how at last He subdued them all, even though outwardly He was crucified. Now, this is an absolute miracle which can in no wise be denied. Indeed, the truth of Christ stands in no need of further proof.

order.why: Distinguish direct recognition from inferred effects.
Read the reported argument from enduring effects.
shortened: You observe that one appeared two thousand years ago, and His effects still persist; another was three thousand years ago, and His influences are still evident. Though physically absent, they exist in the realm of the Kingdom; hence their effects are manifest and their lights radiant. For that which is non-existent has no effect--it is certain that effects result from existence. What influence can come from non-existence? These manifest effects that remain from perfect beings prove their existence.

order.why: Introduce Self, Revelation, words and human capacity.
shortened: Say: The first and foremost testimony establishing His truth is His own Self. Next to this testimony is His Revelation. For whoso faileth to recognize either the one or the other He hath established the words He hath revealed as proof of His reality and truth. This is, verily, an evidence of His tender mercy unto men. He hath endowed every soul with the capacity to recognize the signs of God.

order.why: Connect Person, Revelation and Pen.
shortened: Whereupon, the Tongue of God bid me to write:

Hast thou not heard that My proof is Mine own Being, and My testimony is My Self, and My evidence is My Revelation, and that which floweth from My pen is a path to My knowledge, unattainable to all save those who have severed themselves from all things and passed straight through the world and all that is therein, aloof as a cloud? My proof hath ever been the revelation of My power which pervadeth all that are in the heavens and all that are on the earth.

order.why: Read recognition through the Manifestation’s existence.
Connect the hidden God with His Manifestation.
shortened: Through Him I have caused all creation to testify that there is none other God except Him, the Incomparable, the All-Informed, the All-Wise." He Who is everlastingly hidden from the eyes of men can never be known except through His Manifestation, and His Manifestation can adduce no greater proof of the truth of His Mission than the proof of His own Person.

order.why: Join the Self with what is revealed.
Read steadfast presence and its traces.
Ask how deeds witness to utterance.
Attend to conduct amidst enemies.
Invite examination free from prejudice.
shortened: The Divine Manifestation is clear and evident to such a degree that were all who dwell on earth to contemplate, without prejudice, His traces and characteristics and conditions, or were they to observe them, they would be convinced that He is the Sovereign of existence in the realms of the seen and unseen.

order.why: Read the reported disciples’ initial recognition.
shortened: Verses 14-16:  The Master said that the disciples of Jesus did not at first, believe in Him, because of signs and prophecies.  They did not even remember or understand them until after His death.
