shortened: The worshipper must pray with a detached spirit, unconditional surrender of the will, concentrated attention and a magnetic spiritual passion. His innermost being must be stirred with the ethereal breezes of sanctification. If the mirror of his soul is polished from the dross of all desires the heavenly pictures and sidereal images of the Kingdom of God will become fully reflected therein. Then he will be given the power, to translate these celestial forms into his own daily life and the lives of many thousands.

order.why: Purify the heart through utterance and prayer.
shortened: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Purify thy heart with the water of thy Lord's utterance, the Wronged, the Stranger, and say: I beseech Thee, O Thou in Whose grasp is the reins of all beings and in Whose right hand are the reins of all creation, and I beseech Thee by the Dawning-Places of Thy names and the Daysprings of Thy attributes, and by the light of Thy Word which has shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy Tablets, to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and will accompany me in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Ask for the mirror’s freedom from dust.
shortened: Then I beseech Thee, O my God, to purify their hearts from the dust of contingent things and the soil of created things, that the mirrors of their hearts may be cleansed and there may be reflected therein the wondrous splendors of the lights of Thy luminous beauty.

order.why: Keep the Naw-Ruz petition and its stated omission.
shortened: I implore Thee to help Thy chosen ones through Thy strengthening grace to conform unto that which shall please Thee and to purge them from whatsoever might soil the hem of their garments in Thy days.
Sanctify them, O Lord, with this life-giving water whereby Thou hast sanctified the well-favoured among Thy people and the loved ones who are wholly devoted to Thee.

order.why: Pray to be washed of what does not belong.
Retain the prayer for protected vision.
shortened: Cause them, then, to be numbered among those whose eyes Thou hast cleansed and kept from turning to any one save Thee, and whose eyes Thou hast protected from beholding any face except Thy face.

order.why: Extend the petition to children and kindred.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Lastness which is the same as Thy Firstness, and by Thy Revelation which is identical with Thy Concealment, to grant that they who are dear to Thee, and their children, and their kindred, may become the revealers of Thy purity amidst Thy creatures, and the manifestations of Thy sanctity amongst Thy servants.

order.why: Join inward and outward favor with obedience.
Ask for words to sink deeply into hearts.
shortened: Purify, O my God, the hearts of Thy creatures with the power of Thy sovereignty and might, that Thy words may sink deep into them.

order.why: Connect pure love with sincere devotion.
shortened: Then send upon him that which will purify his heart from the remembrance of aught else besides Thee, that he may become pure in Thy love, sincere in his devotion to Thee, and obedient to Thy decree.

order.why: Read the prayer’s portrait of steadfast, longing souls.
Keep the Bab’s prayer for loved ones.
Join purification with service by one’s kindred.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thyself and by what Thou art, to purify me from whatsoever is abhorrent unto Thy good-pleasure, and to assist me and my kindred to serve and obey Thee.

order.why: Imagine becoming a letter of the Book.
Pray that divine love may be established within.
Join pure intention with constant good deeds.
shortened: I pray God to make you pure and clean from self and desire, obedient to the command of the Lord, attracted by the breaths of God, steadfast in pure intention in the love of God, constant in good deeds and complete sanctification.

order.why: Retain the joy brought by a letter of supplication.
Ask for good together with sincerity.
shortened: I have turned toward the Dawning-Place of Thy mercy and the Dayspring of Thy oneness, supplicating Thee to ordain for me every good thing in Thy Kingdom and make me pure and sincere before Thy gracious countenance.

order.why: Connect sincere turning with continued supplication.
Keep the expansive prayer’s imagery and petition.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Beauty, through whose manifestation the dwellers of the Supreme Paradise rejoiced, and the denizens of the crimson seas in their most exalted retreats were gladdened by its presence, and the Maids of Heaven in the All-Highest Paradise were blessed by its beauty at the Ultimate Lote-Tree, and through which those at Sinai fell unconscious upon the dust of self and passion, and the skin of the sincere ones trembled in the wilderness of fancy and blindness - to preserve us, O my God, from all else but Thee, and purify our hearts from the mention of aught save Thee.

order.why: Ask for worthy remembrance and the fruit of existence.
Retain the brief remembrance of sincere seekers.
shortened: Thou seest Thy loved ones, detached from their homes, turning toward the seat of Thy mighty throne, fleeing from Thy enemies to the shelter of Thy mercy and favors.
And among them, O my God, are those who have sought Thee with pure intention. Therefore, O Lord, accept from them what they have desired in Thy love and good-pleasure.

order.why: Read the Bab’s visitation text and purifying light.
shortened: I testify that Thou art pure, purifying, and purified. Nay, God hath sanctified Thee beyond such mention and purified Thee beyond such praise, for all that turneth toward Thee becometh pure, and every fire that draweth nigh unto Thee becometh light.

order.why: Keep the particular conduct prescribed at the tomb.
Preserve the reported personal analogy without making medical advice.
shortened: Some (persons) with serious ills go from celebrated doctor to celebrated doctor, but they all fail to cure for the power is with the divine. So it is with your soul. Your heart is pure and the Spirit can enter therein. Cut yourself from the world. Pray in the Greatest Name, then the breeze of truth, the flood of light will enter your searching soul. There is nothing else to be sought on earth or in the universe.

order.why: Read remembrance and love as the polish of existence.
shortened: By My life, whoso attaineth unto His knowledge soareth in the atmosphere of His love and detacheth himself from all who dwell on earth, let alone those who speak according to their desires that which God hath not permitted them.

Hear ye the voice of the Wronged One. Speak ye in the name of Truth, and be adorned with the ornament of His remembrance and illumined by the lights of His love. This is the key to hearts and the polish of existence.

order.why: Join knowledge, love and remembrance.
shortened: Sanctify your souls for My knowledge, your hearts for My love, and your tongues for My wondrous remembrance.

order.why: Connect purification with heart and tongue together.
Keep the petition for an undivided heart and tongue.
Read receptive hearts beside remembering tongues.
shortened: O people! Purify your hearts that the lights of your Lord's revelation, the Merciful, the Compassionate, may be imprinted thereon. Then purify your tongues that they may move in remembrance of your Creator, for this is better for you than all that hath been created between the heavens and the earth, were ye but to know.

order.why: Consider worship in every gathering and land.
shortened: In all gatherings and all lands, guide souls to worship and engagement in the remembrance of God, so that through these purifying waters, souls may day by day increase in purity of heart and sanctification of spirit, become manifestations of piety, and arise with what is necessary, fitting and worthy of the Day of the Covenant in terms of inner and outer purity and sanctification of spirit and heart.

order.why: Prepare for a meeting with attentive spiritual purpose.
Read the reported influence of sincerity through translation.
shortened: If the speaker's intention is pure, if his heart is transparent, no matter through how many translators the words may go, the audience is touched.
You must purify your heart. This is the most important thing, otherwise all your learning and philosophy will not assist you.

order.why: Join eloquence with sanctification and attraction.
Consider a sincere word’s influence.
shortened: Every word that issues forth from the mouth with sincerity for God's sake has been and will ever be effective throughout all existence.

order.why: Connect the Word’s influence with the heart’s preparation.
shortened: Ask thou of God that He may sanctify the hems of His servants from the dust of self and passion. The penetrating influence of the Word hath ever been and will continue to be dependent upon the sanctification of the heart.

order.why: Keep inspiration and calling others within service.
shortened: And it is for this that we have given thee inspiration and revealed to thee our verses, that that mayest show thy mettle in the Cause of thy Lord, calling mankind to this path, for thee to be of those who are well guided.

order.why: Join independence of spirit with meekness and joy.
shortened: Let God's beloved, each and every one, be the essence of purity, the very life of holiness, so that in every country they may become famed for their sanctity, independence of spirit, and meekness. Let them be cheered by draughts from the eternal cup of love for God, and make merry as they drink from the wine-vaults of Heaven.

order.why: Imagine patience, quiet and love together.
Draw near with a cheerful face and joyful spirit.
shortened: Draw nigh unto Him with a pure heart, cheerful face, gazing eye and a joyful spirit and plunge with thy whole being into the sea of the love of God and forget all else save Him, so that thou mayest be filled with such spiritual sentiments from the kingdom of God, which will take the reins of desire from thy hands and move thee with the power of thy Lord, just as the wind moveth a mote in the open air as it willeth.

order.why: Keep the tribute to a refined, illumined heart.
shortened: Thanks be to the Most Holy One that, through love for the True Beloved, thou hast rent thy garment and possessest a heart that is illumined, pure and refined.

order.why: Read the joy carried by a sincere letter.
shortened: Your letter reached this station of poverty and evanescence, and its contents, like the breeze from the gardens of the highest paradise, brought spirit and fragrance, for it was written with pure intention, sincere love and complete attention. Such a state is surely among the signs of heavenly bestowals.

order.why: Retain the acknowledgment of a devoted letter.
Keep the praise of another letter’s purity.
Read a child’s character within the father’s example.
shortened: I wish for you luminosity of character and purity and sanctity of behavior, so that you may become of the essence of the soul and heart of that one near to the Divine Threshold, and become "the child is the inner secret of his father."
This is befitting of you and I hope that like your father you will become valiant and like a spiritual rose garden adorned with the flowers of purity and sanctity.

order.why: Keep the particular encouragement to Qudsiyyih.
Remember women whose fidelity is praised.
shortened: All became absolute nothingness and utter non-existence, and shall continue so, except for those gems of sanctity who shone forth like morning stars at the dawn of creation - namely, those women who were dawning-places of the signs of faithfulness and who, with pure hearts and radiant faces, turned toward the Manifestation of "were it not for Thee."

order.why: Read the two handmaidens’ inner and outer dedication.
Connect a handmaiden’s remembrance with exemplary conduct.
Keep sincerity and unity alongside steadfastness.
shortened: Today the handmaidens of God must remain steadfast in the Cause of God with perfect sincerity, unity, sanctity and detachment, and be engaged in His remembrance.

order.why: Read counsel to women in its stated setting.
shortened: We make mention of the handmaidens of that land and counsel them to be chaste and pure, that all may be sanctified from self and passion, may gaze toward the Most Exalted Horizon, and cling to the hem of His grace.

order.why: Retain the counsel to the women of that land.
shortened: We counsel all the women of that land to sanctification and detachment and whatsoever the All-Bountiful hath sent down in the Book.

order.why: Read chastity within continued remembrance.
Keep the invitation to praise.
shortened: The handmaidens of God must in this day engage themselves with absolute sanctity and purity in the utterance of the praise of the Beloved of all creation.

order.why: Preserve the particular protective counsel without generalizing its setting.
Read chastity as an ornament of servants and handmaidens.
Follow greetings across lands with a call to holiness.
shortened: God willing, thou shalt pass through the lands of God with a spiritual breeze from the true, original homeland which is the seat of the Throne, and convey to all the handmaidens the greetings from God, and call all to sanctification and holiness, that all may gaze toward God's direction with illumined breasts, penetrating vision, pure hearts and sanctified souls.

order.why: Keep the charge to inform other handmaidens.
Imagine remembrance imprinted on the heart.
shortened: And thou, O handmaiden of God, purify thy heart from the love of aught else, that the sun of the beauty of thy Lord's remembrance may be imprinted thereon, for verily it hath been recorded by this name in the Mother Book.

order.why: Connect hearts, tongues and limbs in detachment.
Retain the condition of detachment in its source wording.
Move from the narrow self toward generous deeds.
Read the brief counsel concerning bodily comfort.
Keep the invitation toward the Lote-Tree.
shortened: Sanctify yourselves, O people, from this world, then hasten to the Ultimate Lote-Tree in this Farthest Mosque, that ye may hearken unto the call of your Lord, the All-Merciful, in this Paradise which hath been created by the Kawthar of life from the very Spirit of Glory, and before whose gate the people of the holy and guarded pavilions have fallen prostrate.

order.why: Read refinement as receptivity to fragrance.
shortened: Be ye utterly refined, for whoso lacketh refinement shall never perceive the fragrances of the All-Merciful nor associate with the dwellers of the Ridvan.

order.why: Contrast the passing world with enduring bounty.
Guard the pearls entrusted to the heart.
shortened: O friends! Every precious and desirable thing hath thieves in pursuit of it. Therefore, you must preserve with the utmost effort and striving the pearls of divine love--which are the most excellent, delicate and beautiful jewels of the world--within the treasuries of your hearts.

order.why: Read purification within service to the Threshold.
shortened: It is a condition of severance from self and from the defilement of the physical world, of purification of self in the service of the divine Threshold.

order.why: Join virtue, remembrance and steadfastness.
shortened: Let them arise with utmost chastity, with consummate purity, with steadfastness in the Cause, and faithfulness in the Covenant. Let them distinguish themselves through the illumination of their hearts, their unsullied spirituality, and their continual remembrance of His Name and their genuine virtue.

order.why: Imagine purity becoming cleansing service.
shortened: Each of the friends of God must manifest such sanctity that he would purify and sanctify the world, become pure and holy as the light, and should, like unto pure water, wash away every stain.

order.why: Remove what estranges and draw near.
shortened: Sanctify yourselves from all that would remove you from God, then draw nigh with your hearts unto the court of sublime glory.

order.why: Join purification with seeking bounty each day.
shortened: Purify thyself from whatsoever is unworthy of thee, then seek bounty from thy Lord every morn and eve.

order.why: Preserve the stated meaning of reflecting the Great Name.
shortened: It behooveth thee to be sanctified, that thou mayest reflect this Great Name. Know thou that God's purpose in this Name is the sanctification of the soul from His enemies.

order.why: Connect a shared cup of sanctity with action.
Read the rock’s call to prepared hearts.
Remove allusions that obscure illumination.
shortened: Purify thy heart from all allusions, that it may be illumined by the lights of the countenance of thy Lord, the Possessor of Names and Attributes.

order.why: Keep revelation’s water as purification.
Join freedom from egotism with service and sacrifice.
shortened: O my dear one! This day is the day of purification, the day of sanctification, the day of turning toward God, the day of severance from all else save God, the day of lowliness and humiliation, the day of serving the beloved ones of God, the day of becoming utterly destitute of and free from egotism and desire and the day of purity and sacrifice in the path of God.

order.why: Retain the brief image of sanctification’s lights.
shortened: In the world of existence, the greatest purpose is complete attention to the Promised Beauty, and when the heart becomes enkindled and engaged with the Beloved Lord, it inevitably becomes heedless and detached from all else. Therefore, the greatest means of illuminating the heart is through the lights of sanctification.

order.why: Read detachment, sincerity and faithfulness together.
shortened: Today, that which draws one near to the threshold of grandeur is detachment from the world of self and passion, purity of heart, sincerity of intention, and faithfulness.

order.why: Receive the blessing upon praise.
Extend sanctification across the whole person.
Retain the particular counsel about opposing attachments.
Consider the knowledge of what occupies the heart.
Keep the paired counsel to heart and mind.
shortened: Speak naught but truth and walk in no path save that of justice. Sanctify your heart and purify your mind.

order.why: Join freedom from fancy with remembrance.
shortened: Purify yourselves from the veils of idle fancy and your breasts from all doubt. Thus have We commanded you aforetime, and now through a holy and exalted Pen. Then purify your tongues for the remembrance of God, the Most Great, for verily He hath appeared in truth with a sovereignty that encompasseth all the worlds.

order.why: Read standing firmly in love.
Connect remembrance with pleasing character.
Follow devotion through daily movements and desires.
shortened: Sanctify thyself from all that veils thee from the beauty of the Divine Essence, in such wise that thou shalt dwell only in His remembrance, walk only in His name, sleep only by His leave, arise only at His bidding, drink only of His love, gaze only upon His beauty, seek only His presence, and desire only His meeting, that thou mayest enter the City of Immortality in the most exalted Paradise, attain unto every good, and find every light, and be in truth the guided one as thou art named.

order.why: Read pure deeds beside an unencumbered heart.
shortened: O Qasim! Today pure deeds are required, and a heart detached and free. Beseech thou God that thou mayest attain unto this station and enter the kingdom of His good-pleasure.

order.why: Consider divine love as the cleansing means.
shortened: Purify thy heart through the love of God, thy Lord, for by it are all worlds purified.

order.why: Keep acting according to revealed counsel.
Retain the invitation to sanctification and presence.
Join a shared gaze with praise.
shortened: All must, God willing, gaze with utmost sanctity and detachment toward the most exalted horizon and give voice to the praise and glorification of the Lord of Names.

order.why: Read certitude as cleansing water.
shortened: Thou must needs cleanse it with the water of certitude that it may be purified and sanctified from the mention of aught else but Me, and become worthy of this most great bounty and supreme gift.

order.why: Keep the invitation to an undivided love.
Connect truthfulness with entrance into the Kingdom.
shortened: For most of those people possess hearts of utmost purity and innate truthfulness, and today the greatest means of entry into the divine Kingdom is truthfulness and purity of heart.

order.why: Read vision freed from human limitations.
Keep detachment and love beside fidelity.
shortened: O thou who art firm in the Covenant!

Today the glance of the favor of His Holiness, Baha'u'llah is directed to those souls who are full of the love of God, are detached from self and passion and are reflectors of purity, sanctity and piety.

order.why: Let the concise obligation stand.
Interpret empty hands as a heart freed from vain thoughts.
Read the sacrifices aimed at bringing transformed souls into being.
shortened: It is evident that these wanderers have sacrificed all physical and spiritual affairs in the path of God, that perchance souls might come into being and appear in the realm of existence who would be quickened by the holy breaths of the Spirit of God and become the manifestation of sanctification and detachment, so that the brilliant reality of "Purify thy heart for My descent" might be fulfilled.

order.why: Keep the invitation to receive the horizon’s light.
shortened: Remove from thy heart every trace of the conditions of misbelief, that the lights of this luminous horizon may shine upon it.

order.why: Read purity itself as demanded evidence.
shortened: Yet proof is required, and that proof is attraction and rapture, purity and detachment, freedom from defilement, and sanctification and holiness.

order.why: Join holiness with love and servitude.
shortened: There is no way of salvation other than through sanctity and purity, through love and servitude to the All-Glorious Lord.

order.why: Preserve the reported connection with prosperity.
Keep the reported inward discipline.
Retain the question and answer defining purity through selflessness.
Imagine holiness as a perceptible fragrance.
shortened: Fear God, O people, and be of them from whom waft the sweet fragrances of holiness and detachment, and to whose sanctity the Concourse on High bear witness.

order.why: Read the gate image and its demand for freedom from fancies.
Turn a purified heart toward the Countenance.
Keep the particular appeal to relinquish aversion.
shortened: Now purify your heart from aversion to this Youth and from love of His enemies, that healing manifestations may appear from the treasury of mighty oneness.

order.why: Prepare the heart as a receptacle of love.
shortened: Purify thy heart from all allusions, then make it a receptacle for the love of My Name, the All-Merciful, and be not of the heedless.

order.why: Read the stated purpose of the command.
shortened: Say: He has commanded you only to that which would purify your souls from the turbidities of self and passion, yet you heeded not his word and followed the ways of the corrupt.

order.why: Join aiding the Cause with discouraging unseemly deeds.
Connect conduct with the transcendence of the divine.
shortened: It behooveth My loved ones to be sanctified from all things and from whatsoever is repugnant to God's good-pleasure, that through them may be made manifest the sanctification of His Self from any likeness and the exaltation of His Being above any similitude.

order.why: Read the inscription of revelation on the heart.
Associate with a brother for the All-Merciful’s sake.
shortened: Blessed is he who has turned his gaze away from his brother and associated with him in spirit and fragrance, purely for the sake of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Let the heart reflect the revealed light.
shortened: Purify your hearts from all earthly suggestions, that the revelation of your Lord, the All-Merciful, may be reflected therein.

order.why: Keep sanctity within steadfastness.
Preserve remembrance as one’s own life.
Remove what prevents worthy human conduct.
shortened: Today the divine decree in the holy scriptures and tablets is to sanctify oneself from all that preventeth man from that which beseemeth him.

order.why: Return to deeds performed for His sake.
Read service beside the assaying of purity.
Join cleansing with upright character.
Receive the remembrance of a radiant countenance.
Connect a pure heart with an eloquent response.
Read reverence as water preparing the heart’s inscription.
shortened: The heart must needs be purified with the water of the fear of God, that it may be adorned with the inscription of the blessed words "Verily I am God's."

order.why: Keep the particular invitation to the mystics’ gathering.
shortened: O Ali! If you desire to enter the gathering of the mystics, purify yourself from all that souls detest.

order.why: Read the permission to enter within its stated conditions.
Retain the counsel concerning the promptings of opponents.
shortened: Purify thyself from whatsoever hath occurred to thee, and thy breast from the promptings of them who have disbelieved in God and who move about in the wilderness of passion, having deprived themselves of God's mercy.

order.why: Close linked readings with purified senses and wholehearted service.
shortened: O dear one, soul and spirit, beseech the Eternal God that we may attain to that which befits this Day, which is to wholly forget ourselves and others, and arise to serve with a hundred thousand bodies and a hundred thousand souls. The first service is to purify the heart, sight, hearing, inner consciousness and all limbs from that which is unworthy.

order.why: Keep the supplied repeated appeal to righteousness.
Join a remembering heart and listening ear.
Read the supplied provisional translation on sincere intention.
Keep the pilgrim-note account of intention and concentration attributed.
Read the supplied diary account of inspired minds.
Keep the supplied Beatitude and its original references.
Preserve the supplied Upanishadic passages without blending their traditions.
Read the supplied counsel about prayer and guidance.
Remember the soul’s purpose in remembering the Friend.
Keep the entrusted senses and treasury image intact.
Read the daily effort required for love and pure motives.
Close with the supplied relation of mind, action and happiness.

questions: What do these readings identify as defilements of the heart, and how do those descriptions change your understanding of purity?
How might we recognize the difference between sincere service and an action that quietly seeks credit, control, or repayment?
What does the mirror image illuminate about attention, receptivity, and our relationships with other people?
How can childlike simplicity coexist with mature reason, investigation, and the willingness to examine inherited prejudice?
What connections and differences emerge when Psalm 24 and the Dhammapada are read beside these teachings on intention and conduct?
What daily practice might help inward renewal become visible in justice, trustworthiness, or care for others, and which connected subject would help you explore it?

references.label: 1 · Psalm 24:1–6 · Clean hands and a pure heart
references.note: The psalm begins with the earth belonging to God, then asks who may stand in the holy place. Its answer brings together clean hands, a pure heart, and freedom from vanity and deceit. Compare this conjunction with the compilation’s insistence that inward sincerity should become visible in conduct and relationships.

references.label: 2 · Dhammapada 1–5 · Mind, action, and the ending of hatred
references.note: In Acharya Buddharakkhita’s translation, the opening verses connect the quality of mind with speech, action, and their consequences, then examine the thoughts that sustain hatred. Read them beside the calls to relinquish malice, prejudice, and self-interest. Explore this practical affinity while attending to the distinct religious settings and accounts of spiritual transformation.
